scope.active_problem: NBA PRA Page 1 had the correct upcoming slate but returned zero tracked players/fresh markets despite legitimate sportsbook PRA markets.
scope.repair: Use the existing Vercel Runless V2 FastAPI runtime as the first-party Kyre Sports API transport. Streamlit forwards its already-connected SportsGameOdds credential request-scoped; Vercel fetches/normalizes PRA observations; Page 1 admits only observations matching the actual upcoming matchup and calls approved fallback only when needed.
scope.source_contract: Sportsbook identity, exact line, price, provider and observed timestamp are preserved. No consensus averaging, no fabrication, sportsbook projection influence 0.0.

proof.nba_regression: GREEN with two superseded anonymous-fallback direct-injection fixtures deselected
proof.runless_v2_regression: 145/146; sole thaw-retarget failure reproduced identically on untouched main and ruled pre-existing/out-of-scope
proof.live_acceptance: REQUIRED_BEFORE_FREEZE: live Page 1 must show non-zero legitimate PRA players/markets for an upcoming NBA game.

rulings: Vercel kyre-runless-proof is the authoritative runtime; Render is not part of this workstream.
Do not freeze on unit/proof evidence alone if live Page 1 still shows zero players/markets.
Anonymous fallback rows are rejected because they cannot be safely bound to the upcoming game.
Odds-API.io fallback rows now preserve provider_event_id, away_team and home_team at ingestion.
The unrelated Runless thaw-retarget regression is pre-existing on source_main_sha and is not patched from this NBA lane.
